summary: Xylem Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to offer $1.5B of senior notes in three tranches ($500M 5.250% due 2029, $500M 5.450% due 2032, $500M 5.850% due 2037) to finance all or a portion of an acquisition under a defined equity purchase agreement. The notes are senior unsecured obligations and include a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the acquisition is not consummated by August 10, 2027, is terminated, or is abandoned. The offering is not contingent on the acquisition closing, and proceeds will not be escrowed. No price, premium, stake, or target is disclosed, and closing is expected after the notes offering. Watch for acquisition completion risk and overhang given the special redemption timeline.
